name: Liath Sidhe Swarm
body:
LIATH SIDHE SWARM
CR 5

The hillside seems to come alive; hundreds of minuscule warriors charge in your direction, swirling their shining swords over their heads and chanting a strange battle cry: “We won’t obey anyone evermore!”. This could be your worst nightmare, only you didn’t know that until now.

XP 1,600
CN Diminutive fey (swarm)
Init +9; Senses low-light vision, portal sense; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 19, flat-footed 14 (+5 Dexterity, +4 size)
hp 52 (8d6+24)
Fort +6, Ref +11, Will +7; +2 racial bonus vs. enchantment and illusion spells and effects
Immune fear

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee swarm (2d6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 0

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 20, Con 18, Int 11, Wis 8, Cha 11
Base Atk +4; Cmb +4; Cmd 18
Feats Diehard, Endurance, Improved Initiative, Iron Will
Skills Acrobatics +16, Escape Artist +16, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (local) +7, Perception +6, Sleight of Hand +16, Stealth +28, Survival +9; Racial Modifiers +2 Intimidate, +2 Survival
Languages Common, Sylvan (liath sidhe mostly speak their own variant of Sylvan, that is hardly intelligible by not accustomed humans)
SQ stunning discordance

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Portal Sense (Su)

Liath sidhe can sense the presence of dimensional portals, gates, or rifts in a 30-ft. radius.

Stunning Discordance (Su)

A liath sidhe swarm is always accompanied by one or more warsingers. The combination of a warsinger’s discordant music and hundreds of liath sidhe shouting their battle cry in unison has the effect of a piercing shriek spell for 1 round on all creatures within 30 ft., whether they are enemies of the liath sidhe or their allies. After being affected once or succeeding at its Fortitude save, a creature cannot be affected again by stunning discordance for 24 hours.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or horde (1d4 swarms)
Treasure normal

Though liath sidhe squabble a lot among themselves, an offense done to one of them is an offense to the whole clan, and all clans are more or less related by blood. When liath sidhe call all their relatives to battle, they are a veritable force of nature and no unfastened good is safe from theft or destruction. They don’t usually kill their enemies but leave them mangled often beyond recognition.
